author: 岭西策展员
subject: 回纹口钵
text: 该钵也许用于献礼，不能从埋放位置确定。

author: 考古协作方
subject: 坡口钵
text: 燃烧后的留痕支持日常炊煮，另一个同类钵没有测。

author: 雪线馆
subject: ridge bowl
text: The bowl may have held grain. A ritual use has been suggested, without direct evidence.

author: 来稿译者
subject: 回纹口钵
text: The rimmed bowl was definitely used for offerings.
